newsitem.title: USA: Metromail says earnings below expectations.
newsitem.headline: Metromail says earnings below expectations.

text.p: Metromail Corp said Wednesday its sales, earnings and operating cash flow were not as strong as it expected in the second quarter.
The company earlier reported earnings of $2.6 million, or $0.12 a share, compared to $1.5 million, or $0.07, in the second quarter of last year. Sales rose 6.4 percent to $73.8 million.

"Although not as strong as expected, sales, earnings and operating cash flow in the second quarter all increased notably over the first quarter, consistent with Metromail's historical operating patterns," said Barton Faber, Metromail's chairman, in a statement."

"Certain revenue we planned for did not materialize in the quarter. Despite this, we remain committed to our full-year sales and earnings goals and are well-positioned for strong sales, earnings and cash flow growth in the second half of 1997 and in 1998," he said.
Metromail is a database marketing and direct marketing products provider.
